h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Udupi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Udupi

items.pText: Udupi gets some of the heaviest monsoon rain on the west coast, and from June to September the steps, decks and paths around a playground rarely dry out fully. Slippery surfaces are the first thing to plan for. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, temple trusts and housing projects in Udupi at our factory in Vasai East, about 700 km away.

The town is known for the Sri Krishna Matha, and nearby Manipal adds universities, hospitals and many staff families. The coast also brings humidity and salt air. Our trucks come down by road, and our own team or a dealer in south India handles the installation. Send us photos of the site in the rain if you have them, as they show where water collects better than any dry-season visit.

richText.heading: Keeping play areas safe underfoot in heavy rain

c: Rubber flooring is the most useful surface for a wet coastal site, as it drains, dries quickly and grips better than tile or polished stone. Lay it across the full safe play area and on the path to the equipment. Avoid glazed tiles anywhere near the play area.
Sweep standing water and leaves off decks after a heavy shower, since a wet deck is where most slips start. Rope nets, such as the one on the
, give children plenty of handholds. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle the rain and the sea air. See also our

items.q: What is the safest surface for a playground in heavy rain?
items.a: Rubber flooring laid over a drained base. It dries faster than soil, does not turn to mud and gives better grip than tiles or polished stone.

items.q: Do you supply Manipal as well as Udupi?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East to both Udupi and Manipal and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.

items.q: How often should a coastal playground be cleaned in the monsoon?
items.a: Sweep standing water and leaves off decks after heavy rain, and scrub steps every few weeks. Rinse off salt with fresh water, especially on sites close to the sea.
